title: The USAID Files: Internal Documents on Its Work With Big Tech
excerpt: USAID's internal emails and briefings on working with the tech platforms, and its lawyers' advice to keep it secret. Every document, with our findings.
content_html:
In November 2026, USAID – a US government agency – published a large number of its internal emails, briefings and planning papers. The documents reveal that as the agency was working with the tech giants, its lawyers were advising staff on how to make sure this cooperation remains secret. “Keep it out of the Washington Post” – this is how one of the lawyers put it in a July 8, 2024 briefing, while another piece of advice was to “only write things that pass the Washington Post Test.”

The fact that a US government agency was involved in shaping what people around the world could say and see on the largest social platforms is bad enough – but the fact that the main concern of the agency was to keep its activities hidden from the public, makes it even worse.

We have indexed the documents, highlighted the more interesting parts, provided transcripts and captions for the videos, and made everything searchable.

content_html_zh:
In November 2026, USAID – a US government agency – published a large number of its internal emails, briefings and planning papers. The documents reveal that as the agency was working with the tech giants, its lawyers were advising staff on how to make sure this cooperation remains secret. “Keep it out of the Washington Post” – this is how one of the lawyers put it in a July 8, 2024 briefing, while another piece of advice was to “only write things that pass the Washington Post Test.”

The fact that a US government agency was involved in shaping what people around the world could say and see on the largest social platforms is bad enough – but the fact that the main concern of the agency was to keep its activities hidden from the public, makes it even worse.

We have indexed the documents, highlighted the more interesting parts, provided transcripts and captions for the videos, and made everything searchable.
